facts.text: The Julius is on Senovazne Square in the heart of Prague, moments from the city's historic streets.
facts.excerpt: Senovážné Square, in the heart of Prague, moments from the city

facts.text: Vaclav Havel Airport is around 30 minutes away by cab.
facts.excerpt: Václav Havel Airport is around 30 minutes away by cab.

facts.text: The Main Train Station is a six-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The Main Train Station is just a six-minute walk

facts.text: Florenc Bus Station can be reached in six minutes by car.
facts.excerpt: Florenc Bus Station can be reached in six minutes by car.

facts.text: The Julius comes from the House of Julius Meinl, a Central European heritage built on craftsmanship and quality.
facts.excerpt: The Julius comes from the House of Julius Meinl – a Central European heritage built on craftsmanship, quality, and genuine care for people.

facts.text: Julius Meinl's story began in Vienna in 1862, where its founder introduced a new approach to coffee roasting.
facts.excerpt: Our founder introduced a new approach to coffee roasting that set a standard others followed.

facts.text: Next door to the hotel, the House of Julius Meinl Gourmet Shop sells fine chocolates, teas, coffees, jams, wines and prosecco.
facts.excerpt: Next door to The Julius Prague, the House of Julius Meinl Gourmet Shop brings together a carefully chosen selection of fine chocolates, aromatic teas, distinctive coffees, jams, wines, and prosecco.

facts.text: The hotel offers Rooms, Studios and Suites designed around calm, natural materials and considered detail.
facts.excerpt: A collection of Rooms, Studios, and Suites designed around calm, natural materials, and considered detail.

facts.text: The One-Bedroom Suite has a kitchen and distinct living and sleeping areas.
facts.excerpt: Space to settle into and a kitchen to make your own. Distinct living and sleeping areas

facts.text: The Deluxe One-Bedroom Suite with Bathtub is the most spacious One-Bedroom Suite, with a fully equipped kitchen and a generously sized bathtub.
facts.excerpt: Our most spacious One-bedroom Suite. Separate living and sleeping areas, a fully equipped kitchen, and a generously sized bathtub.

facts.text: The One-Bedroom Suite with Terrace adds a private terrace to a suite with separate living and sleeping areas and a fully equipped kitchen.
facts.excerpt: All the space of our One-bedroom Suite, with a private terrace that opens things up further.

facts.text: The Deluxe Studio has a private kitchenette, with living and resting areas flowing into one another.
facts.excerpt: A generous studio with a private kitchenette. The living and resting areas flow naturally into one another.

facts.text: The Deluxe Studio with Terrace has a kitchenette and a private terrace.
facts.excerpt: A spacious studio with a kitchenette and a private terrace.

facts.text: The Superior Room has a king-size bed and a walk-in rainforest shower.
facts.excerpt: A king-size bed, walk-in rainforest shower, and everything considered.

facts.text: Interconnecting Rooms are available.
facts.excerpt: Interconnecting Rooms

facts.text: The Brasserie serves breakfast, lunch and dinner in an Italian-inspired setting, shaped by seasonal ingredients.
facts.excerpt: The setting is Italian-inspired, calm, and unhurried.

facts.text: The breakfast buffet includes fresh pastries, warm dishes, breads, homemade preserves and seasonal local produce.
facts.excerpt: Fresh pastries, warm dishes, breads, homemade preserves, and seasonal local produce

facts.text: Pets are not permitted, except certified service dogs.
facts.excerpt: Pets and other animals are not permitted, with the exception of certified service dogs.

facts.text: Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is until 11:00.
facts.excerpt: Check-in: from 15.00

facts.text: The hotel says its practices align with internationally recognized sustainability standards.
facts.excerpt: Our practices align with internationally recognized sustainability standards.

facts.text: The hotel's spaces and services are designed for business or leisure, a single night or an extended stay.
facts.excerpt: an environment that works for business or leisure, a single night or an extended stay

facts.text: The Julius Journal shares stories, places and seasonal observations from Prague's neighbourhoods.
facts.excerpt: The Julius Journal brings together stories, places and seasonal observations from the neighbourhoods we know best.

facts.text: The team treats every guest like they've been coming for years.
facts.excerpt: a team that treats every guest like they've been coming for years
